title: Lightly Seasoned Mexican Fish Tacos
description: A kid-friendly Mexican dish featuring fish seasoned with a hint of mustard, served in tacos with a snappy twist, this recipe is also suitable for a Buddhist temple gathering as it does not contain any meat from animals that were harmed, using rest-meat or fish instead.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a shallow dish, mix together panko breadcrumbs, cumin, paprika, salt, and black pepper.
Dip each piece of cod into the breadcrumb mixture, coating evenly.
Place the coated cod pieces on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
Drizzle olive oil over the cod pieces.
Bake the cod in the preheated oven for 10-12 minutes or until cooked through.
Warm tortillas by wrapping them in a damp paper towel and microwaving for 20-30 seconds.
Assemble the tacos by placing a piece of cooked cod onto a tortilla, followed by shredded lettuce, diced tomatoes, and a squeeze of lime juice.
